plugin.name: ida-nativeaot
plugin.description: Reconstructs .NET Native AOT (.NET 7/8/9/10) metadata in symbol-stripped binaries: rehydrates the runtime metadata, rebuilds the MethodTable/EEType type hierarchy, names virtual methods, and annotates frozen string literals — then presents it all in a navigable PySide6 metadata browser. IDAPython port of washi1337/ghidra-nativeaot. Requires IDA Pro 9.2+ (PySide6).
